verdict.rationale: Gunderson documents both sides of the table. On the investor side, it says it represents more venture funds than any other law firm and cites investor-side deals such as representing the lead investors in Anthropic's Series H. On the company side, it cites heavy financing volume and PitchBook's most-active-VC-firm ranking. The claim that this gives it current market-terms knowledge from both perspectives is only implied, not documented. missing for 10: an explicit first-party claim or published market-terms data (e.g., deal-terms surveys or benchmarks) showing two-sided market insight, independent corroboration of the fund/investor-side practice depth beyond vendor self-description

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm also represents venture funds and investors, so it knows current market terms from both sides of the table
